scope: Same page multi-image watermarks with independent angles. No image generation, changes to room or publishing.

conditions.series: Three serial independent contexts per stage. Original paw in matched before/after; mixed is three actual cat originals, same 32 tiles per page, reported separately.
conditions.limitations: Laboratory DOM interaction timings and double RAF; not FPS, cold network, Safari, physical phones, battery or long-running measurements.

before.note: Isolated drafts; CPU throttle is laboratory stress, not physical hardware. Repeated native DOM change dispatch and double-RAF observation; pointer slider is actual held mouse.

after.note: Isolated drafts; CPU throttle is laboratory stress, not physical hardware. Repeated native DOM change dispatch and double-RAF observation; pointer slider is actual held mouse.

mixed.note: Isolated drafts; CPU throttle is laboratory stress, not physical hardware. Repeated native DOM change dispatch and double-RAF observation; pointer slider is actual held mouse.

tests.note: 99/100 first batch; original small screen virtual-clock resize test passed in unchanged 8/8 reader recheck. Earlier overlapping 12/13 and 98/99 batches are not added.
earlierCorrections: Pixel comparison uses opacity, since existing page raster intentionally restores visibility for offscreen reader capture.
New duplex test waits for asynchronous preview src.
Own image pool capacity is checked before commit, preventing a success notice from replacing a capacity failure.

production.flow: isolated editor -> multi select / independent angles -> reload / preview / PNG / duplex / physical page / room return
